rules: Pointed external ears and angled eyebrow presentation are recurring Romulan species-readable cues.
Romulans share ancestry with Vulcans but are not a visual clone of the Vulcan profile.
Forehead ridge presentation varies by production era and individual; it is not mandatory on every Romulan.
Broad humanlike facial, skin-tone, hair and age variation remains available.
Hair/grooming are presentation layers, not biological identity.
allowed_variation: forehead ridge presence/shape when era/reference supports it
forbidden_variation: mandatory forehead ridges on every individual
notes: Resolve era before locking forehead-ridge presentation.
